categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor advanced manufacturing and packaging plant construction, cleanroom, control, and electromechanical integration, focusing on system integration services for high-tech industries. It also provides maintenance services and design and product sales, with system integration accounting for over 99% of revenue. The business serves semiconductor, optoelectronics, packaging and testing, solar energy, LED, and biotech industries, with semiconductor clients contributing over 90% of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in system integration involving system control and electromechanical engineering, including computer, communication, instrumentation, automation, electrical, air conditioning, and fire protection installation and testing. It develops wireless security systems using international standards like WIFI and ZIGBEE, and earthquake-resistant cleanroom ceiling systems compliant with US AC156 standards. The company emphasizes advanced cleanroom construction and integration to meet advanced semiconductor process and packaging requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC and Micron, with projects supporting advanced process nodes like 2nm and advanced packaging (CoWoS). The company serves high-tech industries including semiconductor fabs, memory manufacturers, and related sectors. Markets include Taiwan, the US, Japan, China, Singapore, and emerging semiconductor regions, focusing on customers' capital expenditure and expansion plans.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover Taiwan (headquarters and multiple engineering offices), the United States (notably Arizona), China (Shanghai, Jiangxi, Suzhou, Beijing), Singapore, and Japan (Kumamoto). The company is expanding its global footprint to support overseas semiconductor fab construction and cleanroom projects, adapting to regional market dynamics and regulatory environments.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream as a system integrator and engineering service provider in the semiconductor construction supply chain. It manages project execution, integrates electromechanical systems, cleanrooms, and facility infrastructure, coordinating with subcontractors and suppliers of materials and equipment. It does not manufacture semiconductor devices but supports fab construction and facility upgrades.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening involvement in advanced semiconductor fab construction (2nm and advanced packaging), expanding overseas engineering services, and strengthening technical capabilities and project management efficiency. R&D focuses on wireless security systems with AI-enabled image recognition and earthquake-resistant cleanroom ceiling systems. The company aims to optimize cost structures, enhance supply chain integration, and maintain competitive advantages amid geopolitical and market uncertainties.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through system integration project contracts for semiconductor fab construction and facility engineering services. Additional income comes from maintenance services and design/product sales related to security systems and cleanroom components. The company operates on a project-based contract model with milestone payments and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan's high-tech plant construction sector, benefiting from long-term relationships with major clients like TSMC and Micron. It competes with few domestic firms capable of handling large, complex integration projects and leverages local regulatory knowledge and technical support advantages. The company is expanding internationally to strengthen its competitive position against global engineering service providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue was approximately NT$47.4 billion with a pre-tax profit of NT$7.9 billion. The company has shown stable profitability with a net profit margin around 13%, return on assets near 14%, and return on equity exceeding 45%. Despite a revenue decline compared to the prior year, profitability improved due to higher project margins. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets around NT$46.6 billion and equity of NT$14.9 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional expertise, high-quality engineering, and safety management to deliver world-class semiconductor fab construction services. It differentiates through deep technical knowledge, long-standing client trust, and the ability to manage complex, large-scale integration projects efficiently. Its focus on innovation, such as AI-enabled security systems and earthquake-resistant cleanroom solutions, along with strong global market presence, provides competitive advantages and supports sustainable growth.
